column1: # Each row quotes the Go boundary and names the concrete Rust ownership seam or measured fact.

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram.go:56-60 says "Global static chunk for pseudo histograms" and stores sync.Once plus *chunk.Chunk; lines 142-160 rewrite string FieldType collation before returning the shared chunk
column3: Rust Histogram stores owned Datum bounds per Bucket and tidb-stats/Cargo.toml has no Go chunk or FieldType dependency

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram.go:98,113,122 define memory constants with unsafe.Sizeof over Go structs and scalar; MemoryUsage also reads chunk capacity
column3: Rust makes no Go ABI or allocator-size promise and has no chunk capacity field; semantic bucket contents are anchored separately

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram.go:245-286 iterates chunk rows, calls tablecodec.DecodeColumnValue or Datum.ConvertTo, and returns bounds to a Go chunk pool
column3: Rust tidb-stats accepts already decoded Datum values; tablecodec decode and Go pool ownership remain at their codec/allocation boundaries

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram.go:335-361 formats encoded values through SessionVars, codec.DecodeRange, DatumsToString and terror logging
column3: Rust histogram estimation owns decoded Datum arithmetic, not session-aware SQL diagnostic rendering

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram.go:770-899 accepts and mutates []*ranger.Range and uses chunk row comparison to split encoded planner ranges
column3: tidb-stats has no ranger.Range type or planner range dependency; range construction remains with the ranger/planner owner

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram.go:906-955 converts to and from *tipb.Histogram and tests index shape through a nil FieldType
column3: tidb-stats owns decoded histogram arithmetic and has no tipb dependency in Cargo.toml; protobuf transport remains at its wire owner

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram.go:1303-1358 parses encoded index columns with codec.CutOne and queries CMSketch hashes while extracting TopN
column3: Rust key cutting lives in tidb-codec/tidb-tablecodec and is deliberately outside the decoded-Datum histogram boundary

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram.go:1363-1378 uses sync.Pool only to recycle bucket4Merging allocations
column3: Rust BucketForMerging values use ordinary ownership; merge result semantics are observed without promising Go allocator reuse

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram_test.go:537 calls Index.QueryBytes; the production definition is pkg/statistics/index.go:178, not histogram.go
column3: The Rust owner is tidb-stats/src/index_query.rs rather than histogram.rs

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram_bench_test.go:30-108 generates random buckets and reports Go testing.B timing without a semantic assertion
column3: The deterministic merge semantics are ported and mutation-tested; Go runtime benchmark throughput is not a cross-language behavior contract

column2: pkg/statistics/histogram.go:64-71 stores *types.FieldType, *chunk.Chunk bounds, and a []scalar cache directly on Histogram
column3: Rust Bucket owns decoded Datum bounds and calc_fraction_from_datums derives scalar geometry on demand; tidb-stats therefore has no Go FieldType pointer or scalar cache field
